ratings_why.fun: Hold or run is a real choice every turn, and the late game pays off big: Grisel fielding aged copies, the Auctioneer spreading stock across the crew. The hold lane is a little thin on the board before Tier 4.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 over 7 because no other tribe plays in the shop and pool itself: the Customs House is a new zone that holds any tribe's units, so it changes how you draft in every lobby, not only how your board fights.

verdict_why: Two cards don't yet say how they work in a fight (Grisel's copies, Tibby's redirected hit); the rest is ready.

points.text: Say whether Grisel's copies use their own Start of Combat text. A shelf copy of Wenna, the Sentry, Rufa or Grisel herself changes the fight a lot, and a player can't tell what happens.
Tibby Slick: say who takes the hit and whether anyone hits back, e.g. 'the attacker deals its Attack to a random unit beside it instead; that unit doesn't hit back'.

The hold lane banks stats on the shelf that can't fight until the Stoker or Grisel. A small Tier 2 or 3 way to cash shelf stats into a fight (like the Sentry) would let holding win the turn 4 to 7 fights too.
Corporal Rufa stealing a copy of what it kills is the best fight-to-shop link in the tribe; a Tier 3 or 4 version would bring that feeling into the midgame.

standouts.why: Chief Collector Grisel turns the shelf into a second board of aged copies and makes the empty-slot puzzle matter.
Honest Ned turns any tribe's When played into a repeatable one for 2 gold; a great off-label card.
Corporal Rufa takes copies of the enemies it kills: a fight that stocks your shop.

weakest.why: Gammer Eelby is up to 2 gold a turn at Tier 4, late for economy and with a weak body.
Narrows Sentry is a plain count-the-shelf buff with no decision in it.
Tibby Slick does nothing when the attacker has no neighbour, which is often in early fights.

flags.note: Unclear whether summoned copies fire their own Start of Combat effects; a copy of Grisel could summon again.
Grisel with Wenna and Nan after her in reading order buffs every copy; the hold-and-run high roll can stack very high.
Auctioneer Ardley plus Ned laundering your carry spreads half of it to every Contraband unit each turn; bounded by losing the unit, but worth a look.
Keeper of the Stilt House lets free Seizes complete triples at 0 gold; triples could come every few turns.
Doesn't say whether the attacker's neighbour hits back or the attacker takes damage.
